title: Emit control_binding as explicit null in work focus and next once TermAl tolerates it
outcome: Every host read of an item carries control_binding explicitly, so a missing key never has to be interpreted
acceptance: Landed only after TermAl confirms its null-tolerant binding reader (its step 3, or a separate small TermAl commit Greg approves) is installed
Tests pin the explicit null for a non-holder on focus and next
The CLI and control-plane docs describe the explicit null; the full quality gates pass

`work core focus` and the focus nested in `work core next` always carry control_binding: the live claim's binding, or an explicit null when the caller holds no live claim; null and an absent key never mean different things

completion.summary: Core focus, nested next and inspect emit exactly one control_binding object or explicit null; inspect retains complete focus and public accessors, with preserved bind eligibility, byte fitting and historical absent-key reads. Docs updated; full gate, required independent Codex/Kimi pair and independent acceptance4/4 passed. Installed clean release and pushed verified origin/master.
